title: Evidence type fabric.test.items/v1 (spec 050 §3.4a item 7)
description: One item of the carrier's test type: a named, counted, digested entry with an optional reference to a body object by its index in refs and an optional actor id. Closed: no other property, no free text. actor is an ID in mapped form (act- v2); its x-fabric-clear alternative (the opaque clear id or its h- form) is admitted only when the record's source manifest declares identity_mode clear (spec 050 §3.4a item 2, R8).

actor.description: ID: act- + 32 hex (v2), or the clear-mode form under identity_mode clear.
